item.title: Nebraska bill would expand insurance coverage for Alzheimer’s tests and treatments
item.description: LINCOLN, Neb. (KLKN) — A new bill in the Nebraska Legislature could expand access to testing and treatment for people living with Alzheimer’s disease and related dementia. State Sen. Jason Prokop introduced the measure, which would require insurance companies to cover certain Food and Drug Administration-approved tests and treatments for Alzheimer’s disease.
